goal: Fill the project with a professional-quality offline audio bank for voice, music, ambience, fauna, foley, combat and creatures while preserving the existing dynamic routing and low-spec runtime budget.

approval_boundaries.real_actor_voice_cloning: REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_AUTHORIZATION; film samples alone are not approval.

voice: 3D attachment to speaking actor when present

first_bank_order: P1C01 Shire ambience + footsteps + Hobbit interiors + Frodo/Sam/Gandalf voice placeholders from authorized/original source

technical_contract.source_format: WAV preferred for authored masters; imported/compressed runtime settings chosen in UE4.27 per category.
technical_contract.spatial_audio: Use 3D attenuation for localized ambience/fauna/foley/voice emitters; persistent non-local score remains 2D.
technical_contract.concurrency: Bound simultaneous fauna/foley/voice emitters and prioritize story-critical cues.
technical_contract.dynamic_mix: Preserve existing ambience/music crossfades and voice ducking from Part1SonicWorldPlan.
technical_contract.low_spec: Profile source count, decompression mode, concurrency and resident memory on i7 Gen6/8GB/~2GB VRAM target.

acceptance_boundary.compile: requires exact-head UE4 gate when runner is healthy
acceptance_boundary.pie: not accepted until chapter-specific listening review
acceptance_boundary.device: not accepted until target-laptop mix/performance observation
